# SEO Agent Kit

Live site: https://harryroger798.github.io/seo-agent-kit/
Repository: https://github.com/harryroger798/seo-agent-kit

> A public, agent-readable SEO operating system: skills, prompts, playbooks, checklists, templates, schemas, MCP/API adapters, and a 90-day plan.

## Start

- [README](README.md): what the kit is, quickstart, repo map.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the agent contract, intake, tool protocol, rules.
- [BOOTSTRAP.md](BOOTSTRAP.md): copy-paste prompt for any AI.
- [kit.json](kit.json): machine-readable manifest of capabilities and tools.
- [docs/00-start-here.md](docs/00-start-here.md): the three ways to use the kit.

## Skills

- [seo-orchestrator](skills/seo-orchestrator/SKILL.md): routing and intake.
- [silo-builder](skills/silo-builder/SKILL.md): five-silo cluster.
- [content-factory](skills/content-factory/SKILL.md): brief to article.
- [humanizer](skills/humanizer/SKILL.md): edit without inventing.
- [repurposer](skills/repurposer/SKILL.md): platform-native distribution.
- [product-listing](skills/product-listing/SKILL.md): digital product listing.
- [directory-submission](skills/directory-submission/SKILL.md): verified listings.
- [paid-social](skills/paid-social/SKILL.md): Facebook/WhatsApp campaigns.
- [ai-visibility](skills/ai-visibility/SKILL.md): GEO/AEO measurement.
- [technical-audit](skills/technical-audit/SKILL.md): 120-point audit.
- [local-seo](skills/local-seo/SKILL.md): GBP, NAP, reviews, area pages.
